hypothesis: The failed fixed pullback policy mixes recoverable pullbacks with genuine deterioration. A causal admission model using the pre-HOT candidate state and the observed path through the first 2% pullback can reject bad states while keeping a positive subset.
population: all scored full-HOT candidates on already-opened dates; no candidate-probability prefilter
entry_trigger: first causal state within 10 clock minutes that is at least 2% below the running post-HOT high
model_inputs: candidate probability from the frozen earlier-day candidate model
causal post-HOT open-price path features observed only through the pullback trigger
targets: realized return and positive-return class under the one frozen downstream policy; never future-best value
development_rule: May11-20 is evaluated only if one May8 admission gate passes; the selected numerical threshold is frozen.
forbidden: candidate-probability prefilter before joint admission learning
using May11-20 to choose the admission threshold
using one-second data in this clean causal diagnostic
settling missing deadlines at earlier or later prices
next_if_pass: Learn recurrent ENTER/WAIT and then HOLD/EXIT around the admitted pullback state.
next_if_fail: Add causal completed-minute state features or redesign the pullback trigger without tuning on June15-19.
